table.retrieve:
SELECT 	
	Item.Name,  
	aliasname=item.customicode, 
	active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	PurPrice = Case When (isnull(sum(cast(GodownDetail.CurrQty as int)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN Item.PurPrice Else Round(Item.PurPrice/Item.PackUnits,2) End, 
	SalePrice = 
		CASE WHEN (isnull(sum(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN 
			CASE :ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN Item.SalePrice WHEN 2 THEN Item.PurPrice ELSE MAX(Item.AvgPrice) END 
			ELSE CASE :ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN Round(Item.SalePrice/Item.PackUnits,2) WHEN 2 THEN Round(Item.PurPrice/Item.PackUnits,2)  ELSE MAX(item.avgprice) END 
		END, 
	Item.PackUnits,   
	QTY = Case When (isnull(sum(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN  (isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) / Item.PackUnits ) Else isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0)  End,
	LoosePack = Case When (isnull(sum(CAST(GodownDetail.CurrQty AS INT)),0) % Item.PackUnits ) = 0 THEN ' ' Else 'L' End,
	Manufacturer.name,
	stockvalue=isnull(sum(godowndetail.currqty),0) * (case :ai_pricetype when 1 then Round(item.saleprice/(case item.packunits when 0 then 1 else item.packunits end),2) when 2 then Round(item.purprice/(case item.packunits when 0 then 1 else item.packunits end),2) when 3 then max(item.avgprice) end)
FROM 	
	Manufacturer,   
	Item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN GodownDetail ON (Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode)
WHERE 
	( Item.active=1) and
	( Item.manfcode=manufacturer.manfcode) and
	( Item.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)) 
GROUP BY 
	Item.name,
	item.customicode, 
	Item.Active, 
	Item.purprice, 
	Item.SalePrice, 
	Item.PackUnits,
	Manufacturer.name

objects.name: t_saleprice
objects.text: if( ai_pricetype = 1, 'Sale Price', if( ai_pricetype = 2, 'Pur. Price', 'Avg. Price'))
